notes: Host club board, a Kabukicho staple. Reworded after v1/v2 came out as a photo of an empty billboard.
prompt: photorealistic advertising photography, professional studio lighting, commercial print ad, 80s/90s Japanese magazine ad aesthetic, shot on film, glossy poster finish, five stylish young adult Japanese host club hosts in sharp black suits with voluminous dyed hair, confident poses, a champagne tower beside them, glossy gold and black studio photography, full-bleed photograph, wide horizontal composition, subject off-centre to one side, the background scene continues across the whole frame, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark
purpose: Kaburo (Neon Core) building-side and rooftop billboards: the district's nightlife economy, including its shadier side (love hotels, host and hostess clubs, easy loans). Adult ads are suggestive, not explicit, like real public signage in a Japanese entertainment district.
